name: How can I improve the lighting in my bathroom without a major renovation?
description: Upgrade bulbs, add task lighting around mirrors, use dimmer switches, and consider a decorative lamp for improved bathroom lighting.

mainEntity.name: How can I improve the lighting in my bathroom without a major renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can significantly improve bathroom lighting without a full renovation. Start by upgrading existing fixtures with brighter, more energy-efficient bulbs. Add task lighting around the mirror, such as sconces or an LED strip. Consider a dimmer switch for overhead lights to create different ambiances. A well-placed floor lamp or small table lamp can also add warmth and indirect light.
acceptedAnswer.description: Upgrade bulbs, add task lighting around mirrors, use dimmer switches, and consider a decorative lamp for improved bathroom lighting.
